integrity_notes: The analytic argument proves the infinite-support threshold. Exact-rational and high-precision checks are reproducibility aids and are not substituted for an infinite proof. The existing geometric-sum representation and logarithmic generating-function criterion are expressly credited as prior theory.
scientific_limitations: The original discrete Bilal work has a reported 2020 month-only public posting and a 2022 journal issue; no exact posting day for the earlier month was independently established. The 2021-11-02 arXiv record is a verified exact-date antecedent, not a claim that the model first existed on that day.
A 2024 paper on the discrete hypoexponential law overlaps the object. Its abstract was inspected, but the full text was not available, leaving residual priority uncertainty.
No independent mathematical audit, external validation, or claims for arbitrary bin widths or dependent stages.
title: A sharp factor-two infinite-divisibility threshold for binned two-stage exponential lifetimes
